misc: Waters the course more than the course sprinklers.
biography: Pekka occupies a singularly memorable and hydrated position within the storied chronicles of the Hector Trophée, bringing his refined golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Espoo Ringside Golf to the esteemed pair competition across seven distinct editions. Away from the pristine links, this dedicated competitor is lightheartedly celebrated among his companions for an unusually high liquid intake, leading to the running local joke that Pekka manages to water the course far more effectively than the automated course sprinklers ever could.

Beyond his humorous personal habits on the links, Pekka has etched his name permanently into the tournament's record books through stellar competitive achievements. He has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on one memorable occasion, triumphantly securing the prized team silverware. While the individual accolades represented by the Victor Trophy have thus far remained outside his personal collection across his seven tournament appearances, his ongoing involvement in the vibrant community surrounding the event ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains fully open, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next masterclass on the course.
